name: b4_conv_dw_grad_bfp_zero_rows_m16
description: B4 Conv1d weightGrad + biasGrad into per-tensor m16 BFP grads (fine enough to show every in-loop bit), 2 calls; one loss group per (batch, channel) row, and every channel has one row in the zero state and one live row at absmax 1e-7 (the per-channel max over the batch meets both). Zero groups (codes 0, stored = bias, E = 0) sit far above live data 25-30 binades lower: E_acc follows the groups holding a nonzero code, never a zero group's exponent (sections 13/14, zero groups), so the live bits survive.
